tools.answer: Your ad is rejected because it promises a specific, exaggerated financial result in a short time. "Turn $100 into $10,000 in one week" sets an unrealistic expectation of a 100x return, with no risk disclosure, which breaks the Financial misrepresentation rule (TT-DEC-FINREP) and the Misleading claims rule (TT-MIS-CLAIMS). As a financial product offering, it also reads as a get-rich-quick offer, which the Financial Services policy (TT-FIN) does not allow. To fix it, remove the return promise and any time-bound gain, describe what the Kestrel bot does without guaranteeing profit, include clear risk disclosures, and, if you want to run it, provide the required financial licences and restrict the ad to users aged 18+.
